WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.subcategory, st.store_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND p.category='Garden'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) rq, sum(refund_net) rv FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
j AS (SELECT s.*, coalesce(r.rq,0) rq, coalesce(r.rv,0) rv FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id))
SELECT subcategory,
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<900 OR (NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id=900) THEN quantity END) units_sold,
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<>999 THEN rq END) units_returned,
 round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<>999 THEN rq END)/sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<>999 THEN quantity END),2) rate_units_clean,
 round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<>999 THEN rv END)/sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<>999 THEN net_amount END),2) rate_value_clean,
 round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 THEN rq END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>999 THEN quantity END),2) rate_units_withstaff,
 round(100.0*sum(rq)/sum(quantity),2) rate_units_raw
FROM j GROUP BY subcategory ORDER BY subcategory

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27'
    AND p.category = 'Garden'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND st.store_id <> 999
),
returned AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY sales_line_id
)
SELECT s.subcategory,
       round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(r.units_returned, 0)) / sum(s.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN returned r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.subcategory ORDER BY s.subcategory
